products.product_name: Conjure 4-Piece Channel Tufted Upholstered Fabric Sofa by Modway
products.product_description: Modern appeal surrounds the Conjure Channel Tufted Upholstered Fabric 4-Piece Sofa. Soft and durable fabric upholstery covers dense foam padding and an individually wrapped spring coil system for a supportive living room sofa that will become the go-to lounge spot for family and friends. Vertical channel tufting and subtle French piping adds depth to this vintage inspired sectional sofa that effortlessly becomes the focal point in your living room. Solidly constructed from wood and plywood, this sofa features non-marking foot caps and boasts a matte black base. Versatile and elegant, this sectional sofa is ideally suited for a variety of decor styles in your living room, lounge, or home office. Each Seat Weight Capacity: 331 lbs.

Relax and follow the vertical channel tufting for a streamlined look that adds retro modern glamour to your living room, lounge, or home office. Soft, stain-resistant performance velvet upholstery creates a luxurious tactile experience while dense foam padding and an individually wrapped spring coil system provide ultimate comfort and support for this sectional sofa. Solidly constructed from eucalyptus wood and plywood, this sectional sofa is an eye-catching addition. Sanguine's palatial accents and premium comfort rest securely on a gold stainless steel base that complements any contemporary modern home or apartment. Includes non-marking foot pads to protect flooring and modular connectors. Each Seat Weight Capacity: 330 lbs.

Luxuriously soft, stain-resistant performance velvet upholstery covers dense foam padding and an individually wrapped spring coil system for a supportive living room loveseat that will become the go-to lounge spot for family and friends. products.product_description: Create an atmosphere of balance and warmth in your living room, family room, entryway, or apartment with the relaxed sophistication of the Corland Upholstered Leather Sofa. The cultured profile of this mid-century modern couch beckons with the complementing curves of the armrests and the pillowy back cushions rising above the back frame, adding softness and stature. products.product_name: Corland Upholstered Fabric Loveseat by Modway
products.product_description: Create an atmosphere of balance and warmth in your living room, family room, entryway, or apartment with the relaxed sophistication of the Corland Upholstered Fabric Loveseat. The cultured profile of this mid-century modern loveseat beckons with the complementing curves of the armrests and the pillowy back cushions rising above the back frame, adding softness and stature. Amply padded with dense foam, the seat cushions of this living room loveseat are nestled between sleek, sloped armrests flowing into black powder-coated metal legs with non-marking foot caps. This two-seater-sofa is well-crafted on a sturdy plywood frame with a superior spring coil support system and tailored in top-quality polyester fabric bringing high-performing design integrity into your home office or library. Corland is shipped in a convenient, easy-to-maneuver box with easy assembly instructions. Cushions are zippered and removable. Weight Capacity: 661 lbs.
